newsitem.title: SPAIN: Mapfre Argentina in deal to sell 20 pct of Patagoni. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Mapfre Argentina in deal to sell 20 pct of Patagoni. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]

text.p: Spanish insurance group Mapfre said on Monday its Argentinian subsidiary had agreed a deal to sell up to 20 percent of La Patagonia Cia Argentina Seguros.
(Corrects headline and text to show Mapfre is selling, not buying, the stake.)
The price of the deal was not made public.

"The agreement refers to the insurance portfolio derived from the sales and distribution channels of La Patagonia and aims to pass on the business portfolio to Mapfre Aconcagua," Mapfre said in a statment.
La Patagonia is controlled by the family-held group Perez Companc.
